MEETING TRANSCRIPT
------------------
Priya: Alright, sprint planning for August 10th through the 21st. We've got the mobile release on the 20th, so this sprint is mostly about getting that out the door cleanly. Let's go through the board. First up: the Android crash.

Marcus: Yeah, that's the photo upload crash on Android 14. Crash reports show a NullPointerException in the media picker callback when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload. It's our top crasher right now, about 4% of Android sessions. Repro is: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. I can take it.

Priya: Please do, and I'd like it fixed and verified by Wednesday so QA has time before the release. Sam, can you confirm the fix on the Android 14 test devices once Marcus lands it?

Sam: Yep, I'll add it to the regression run.

Priya: Next, offline mode for the notes list. We promised this to the enterprise customers last quarter.

Elena: The backend side is a sync API: the client sends its last-synced timestamp and gets a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. I'll build that endpoint this sprint. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now; we agreed we're not doing merge UI in this pass.

Marcus: And I'll do the client side: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay them when connectivity comes back. Acceptance criteria as I understand it: you can open the app in airplane mode, see your notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when you're back online with no data loss.

Priya: That's exactly the bar. Write that into the ticket, please. Third item: CI. Jenkins fell over twice last week and nobody knows how to fix the plugin soup anymore.

Sam: I want to migrate our pipelines to GitHub Actions. I've already got a proof of concept for the build job. This sprint I'd finish the test and release pipelines, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both systems in parallel for a week before we turn Jenkins off.

Priya: Approved, but keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean. Elena, there was also the search thing from the incident review?

Elena: Right. The search endpoint got hammered by a misbehaving script last week and degraded for everyone. I'm going to add per-user rate limiting: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that. It also needs a metrics counter so we can see who's hitting the limit.

Priya: Good. One more compliance item: legal flagged that our consent screen doesn't meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. Marcus, we need the privacy policy screen updated so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. That has to be in the August 20 release, it's a launch blocker.

Marcus: Understood. I'll get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen. Opt-in toggles, nothing pre-checked.

Priya: Last one. Sam, the payments flow still has no automated coverage and it burned us in the last release.

Sam: I'll write regression tests for the payments flow: purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.

Priya: Great. Quick note before we wrap: we're still interviewing for the second backend role, two candidates in the loop, but nothing for this group to do there. Also Elena is out the 17th and 18th, so plan reviews around that.

Elena: I'll have the sync API in review before I'm out.

Priya: Perfect. Demo day is the 21st as usual. Thanks, everyone.

---------------------------------------
[0] Fix Android 14 photo upload crash on backgrounding: Fix NullPointerException in media picker callback when user backgrounds app mid-upload. Owner: Marcus. Acceptance criteria: crash no longer reproduces, crash rate for this issue drops to zero in reports, fix landed and ready for QA by Wednesday Aug 13. Related to mobile release on Aug 20.
[1] Verify Android 14 photo upload crash fix on test devices: QA verification of the Android 14 photo upload crash fix. Owner: Sam. Steps: once Marcus lands the fix, add verification to regression run and test on Android 14 test devices using repro steps: start photo upload, background app mid-upload, return. Acceptance criteria: no crash observed, behavior matches expected upload resume/completion, test passes regression suite.
[2] Implement backend sync API for offline notes: Build sync endpoint for notes offline mode. Owner: Elena. API should accept client last-synced timestamp and return delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution: last-write-wins for this sprint, no merge UI. Acceptance criteria: endpoint returns correct delta, handles edge cases, unit tests pass, PR created for review before Elena is out on 17th-18th.
[3] Implement client offline cache and sync for notes list: Client-side offline support for notes list using Room local cache with write queue. Owner: Marcus. Requirements: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay writes when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: app can be opened in airplane mode and notes are visible; notes can be edited offline; on reconnect, changes reconcile with backend with no data loss; works with backend sync API; ticket updated with acceptance criteria as discussed.
[4] Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions: Replace Jenkins pipelines with GitHub Actions. Owner: Sam. Proof of concept for build job exists. This sprint finish test and release pipelines, keep nightly build schedule. Run Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week before decommissioning Jenkins. Acceptance criteria: build, test, and release jobs run successfully in GitHub Actions, nightly schedule preserved, parallel run is clean for one week, Jenkins remains alive until sign-off.
[5] Implement per-user rate limiting for search endpoint: Add rate limiting to search endpoint to prevent abuse. Owner: Elena. Requirements: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when limit exceeded. Add metrics counter to identify users hitting limit. Acceptance criteria: limit enforced per user, correct 429 response with Retry-After, metrics exposed and visible, no impact to normal traffic.
[6] Update privacy consent screen for GDPR compliance: Update consent screen for EU launch. Owner: Marcus. Legal flagged current screen non-compliant. Requirements: consent must be opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, no single pre-checked box, nothing pre-checked. Get new copy from legal and rebuild screen. Acceptance criteria: screen shows separate opt-in toggles for analytics and marketing, all toggles default off, consent recorded correctly, feature included in August 20 release as launch blocker.
[7] Add automated regression tests for payments flow: Create automated test coverage for payments flow. Owner: Sam. Cover purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation path. Acceptance criteria: tests pass locally, run as part of new GitHub Actions CI pipeline, provide regression coverage for payments flow to prevent recurrence of last release issue.
